description: Contract for the AIML pattern bank → Micronaut dispatch lane-set wiring. Defines how <sync> declarations in a pattern bank entry flow into the lane_set binding of xcfe.aiml-micronaut-dispatch. The MML authority document (XaimlMicronautDispatch.mml) defines the Admit formula; this contract wires the formula to the XCFE program layer. The key invariant is that lane_set must be bound at Wo from static pattern declarations — never derived at Sek from runtime state.

current_state.note: The MML system produces RouteProposals only. xcfe.aiml-micronaut-dispatch is the admitted dispatcher that acts on proposals.

mml_authority.write_mode_status: defined but gated — not present in any current micronaut-routing.aiml pattern; requires Xul + XCFE authorization

LaneSet.description: Typed set of (LaneType, SyncMode) pairs extracted from a pattern's <sync> elements.

PatternSyncDecls.description: Extraction function: PatternSyncDecls(pattern) → LaneSet. Reads all <sync> child elements of the matched pattern's <micronaut> template and returns their (lane, mode) pairs.
PatternSyncDecls.input: aiml_pattern — the matched AIML pattern descriptor, already bound at Wo

CandidatePattern.description: A pattern generated by the Question Engine or learning process, held in pattern_bank.candidates at sigma='observed'. Not executable until all invariants pass and sigma reaches 'validated'.

invariants.description: The named Micronaut must be registered before dispatch. An unregistered name is a MISS_capability, not an error to suppress.
The capability declared on <xaiml:micronaut> must be in the target's registered capability set. Eligibility check before W·C·R scoring.
The phase declared on <xaiml:micronaut> must be supported by the target. Phase position is part of program validity, not merely execution order.

invariants.text: ∀ b ∈ pattern.bindings: b.source resolves ∧ b.type ∈ BindType
invariants.description: All <xaiml:bind> declarations must resolve to non-null wildcard captures with valid type annotations. GAP: COMPARE * AND * binds left(1) and right(2) but <xaiml:invoke input='left'/> only forwards left — right is bound but not passed.

invariants.text: ∀ l ∈ lane_set: l.mode ∈ current_lane_modes ∧ lane_set ⊆ PatternSyncDecls(aiml_pattern)
invariants.description: All declared lane modes must be in the currently permitted set (read, retrieve, score, propose). write mode is defined but gated. The dispatch program may only access lanes declared in the pattern — no ambient access.

invariants.mml_term: (wiring invariant — not in MML Admit formula)
invariants.text: lane_set binding phase = Wo; not Sek or later
invariants.description: The lane_set must be bound at Wo (binding phase) via pattern_sync_decls. Binding at Sek or later would allow runtime state to determine lane accessibility, violating the static declaration requirement.

invariants.mml_term: (promotion gate — not in MML Admit formula)
invariants.text: candidate ∈ pattern_bank.candidates → not executable until PB1–PB5 all pass
invariants.description: A candidate pattern enters the bank at sigma='observed'. It cannot be promoted to sigma='validated' until all five MML Admit conditions pass. The Question Engine may generate candidates freely; only the validation gate controls promotion. Micronauts evolve patterns without acquiring authority to rewrite the phase law.

field_resolution.description: How a VectorLane wildcard capture resolves to a FieldParamRecord GML and becomes a scored BoundResult. Governed by WildcardFieldResolution.mml.
field_resolution.sync_timing: Wo bind declares lane_set (accessible). Sek sync calls the field (executed). The pipeline runs at Sek sync, not at Wo bind — captures are bound before sync fires.

euclidean_gradient_field.gml.consumer: geodesic propagator steepest-ascent path (curl=0 → no holonomy)

field_resolution.bound_result_invariant: Every VectorLane result carries source_gml provenance. semantic_authority=false. Scores rank at Yax W·C·R; they do not authorize a route.
field_resolution.lookup_miss: DATA_ONLY — capture key matches no key_family; no projection attempted

sigma_promotion_gate.authority: XCFE policy + Ch'en verification; not self-granted by the pattern
